Key.English: Confidence floor
Confidence never falls below this while the contact is remembered.
Confidence half-life (s)
Confidence in a contact halves every this many seconds without new evidence.
Contact memory (s)
A group forgets a contact this long after the last evidence. Until then it is "last known" and drives search.
Debug
Draw the picture on the map
Every 5 seconds, one map marker per contact and one per threat centre for every HOSTIS group. For testing only.
Reveal reported contacts to the engine
When a report arrives, reveal the reported unit to the receiving leader at knowledge 1 so his men look that way. Off until tested: the engine may raise it to the side's best knowledge instead.
Position error cap (m)
The circle never grows wider than this.
Position error growth (m/s)
How fast the circle around a moving contact's last known position grows. A contact last seen static grows five times slower.
Knowledge
Leaderless delay factor
Reports from a group that just lost its leader take this many times longer and are this many times likelier to be lost.
Leaderless time (s)
How long a group counts as leaderless after its leader falls.
Merge radius (m)
Reported contacts of one type this close together are treated as one contact.
Reports and radio net
Report delay (s)
Base time before a contact report reaches another group.
Report interval (s)
A group sends its contacts at most this often.
Report loss chance
Chance that a report never arrives. Tripled while the group has lost its leader, doubled while the sender is suppressed.
Report speed (m/s)
One extra second of delay per this many metres between the groups.
Contacts per group
Most contacts a group remembers. The weakest reported ones are dropped first.
Sensor sweep range (m)
How far the sweep asks the engine for targets the group's men have detected. It does not make them see further.
Extra eyes per sweep
How many men besides the leader, rotating, feed the picture each sweep.
